game.title: Naija Whot
game.tagline: Match the card, call your shape, and empty your hand first!
game.howto.1: Match the top card by shape or by number. Tap a card to pick it, tap it again (or flick it up) to play it. Can't play? Tap the market to draw one.
game.howto.2: Whot 20 goes on anything. After you play it, you call the shape you need. It is best kept for the end.
game.howto.3: 1 Hold On: play again. 8 Suspension: the next player loses a turn. 14 General Market: everybody else picks one card, then you play again.
game.howto.4: 2 Pick Two and 5 Pick Three: the next player must pick 2 or 3 cards, unless they answer a 2 with another 2, or a 5 with another 5 (you can change this in Rules).
game.howto.5: When you are down to your last card, press Last card. If you forget and a CPU catches you, you pick 2 cards. You can catch them too: tap Catch.
game.howto.6: Be the first to empty your hand and you win. The computer players follow the same rules you do.
rules.title: Rules
rules.note: The computer players follow the same rules you do. Lagos house rules are the default.
rules.stackTwo.help: Play a 2 on a Pick Two and the penalty grows by 2 for the next player.
rules.defendFive.help: Play a 5 on a Pick Three and the penalty grows by 3 for the next player.
rules.whotOnPending.help: A Whot 20 can be played on a Pick Two or Three and cancels it. Off by default.
rules.finishOnSpecial.help: You may go out on any card, power cards too. Off: your last card cannot be a power card, so you must draw.
rules.marketAgain.help: After a 14, everybody else picks one card and you play again.
rules.lastCard.help: Press Last card when you have one card. If you forget and get caught, you pick 2 cards.
rules.semiLast.help: Also call Semi-last card at two cards. Needs Last card on.
rules.marketEnds.help: When the market runs out, the game ends and the lowest hand total wins (Whot counts 20).
rules.calmLate.help: In a very long game (after 240 turns) a 2, 5 or 14 stops hurting: it is just a card, so hands can finally empty. Off: the classic game with no limit.
rules.autoDraw: Draw for me when nothing fits
rules.autoDraw.help: With no card to play, the market draws for you after a short pause.
rules.fastPlay.help: Quicker animations and CPU pauses for long games.
results.endedBy.cap: This game ran very long, so the lowest hand total won.
results.endedBy.market: The market ran out, so the lowest hand total won.
